session.title: Easy Suito recovery continuity
session.purpose: Absorb Monday's haze-day Suito 3x8 session while preserving a low-cost bike-specific touch before Wednesday's provisional displaced Stumpjumper session.
session.dose: With a clean post-Monday recovery gate, ride 30-40 minutes seated at 110-120 W and RPE 2 with normal cadence; no torque, tempo or intervals. A failed recovery gate converts the day to complete rest.
session.adaptation_hypothesis: Very low-cost circulation can support recovery and bike continuity without adding meaningful density before Friday's Enduro exposure.
execution_rules: Fresh same-day evidence governs whether the optional spin occurs.
Keep power smooth and finish fresher than the start.

expected_result.session: No accumulating leg heaviness or sympathetic activation.
expected_result.next_day: Normal or improved freshness for Wednesday's conditional MTB work.

stop_rules: Convert to complete rest for poor sleep, gastrointestinal or respiratory symptoms, illness, pain, abnormal fatigue, impaired CNS readiness or a triggered-but-continued Monday session.
Stop if RPE rises above 3 or legs worsen.
